rules: This is the book-vault repository. All book notes live in md/{L1}-{L2}-{L3}/Slug.md according to the 3-level taxonomy.
Always run 'python -m automation.validate_vault' after generating or modifying book notes.
Pipeline uses OpenCode Zen x-preview-f-free (Ox Alpha) as primary model with 20 retries.
Run 'pytest tests/ -v' after making changes to automation scripts.
